description: This file defines the QuicFramer class and related interfaces for parsing and constructing QUIC protocol packets, including frame processing, encryption/decryption, and version negotiation.

classes.name: QuicFramerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for callbacks during packet processing, including error handling, frame parsing, and key updates.

classes.name: QuicFramer
classes.description: Main class for parsing and constructing QUIC packets, handling encryption, version negotiation, and frame serialization.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes a UDP packet for parsing as a QUIC packet.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Serializes a packet with given header and frames into a buffer.

methods.name: SetDecrypter
methods.description: Sets the primary decrypter for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: SetEncrypter
methods.description: Sets the encrypter for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: DoKeyUpdate
methods.description: Performs a key update for the connection.
